claim_text: Re-attack of the pronephros TF-set INDUCTION question with two added lenses (literature = EuropePMC; native perturbation = ZFIN loss-of-function, raw cached per §7.9). HONEST RESULT (causal-pruner HYPOTHESIS, human-gated): induction by an EXTRINSIC SIGNAL is NOT resolved by native data -- no extrinsic signal carries native induction-role evidence; the best candidate is posteriorizing Wnt at ortholog (WNT1->PAX2/PAX8) + literature tier, and sufficiency (GOF) was not tested. What native LOF DID establish (role-matched): osr1 is the most-upstream TF WITHIN the program (osr1 LOF -> intermediate-mesoderm pax2a decreased + lhx1a absent, PMID:36359386/24722440), itself downstream of RA and upstream of wnt2b -- a node, not an extrinsic signal; wnt8a is NECESSARY for the posterior mesodermal FIELD (LOF -> broad mesoderm disruption/dorsalization, PMID:16216234/11703928) -- permissive, necessity != induction; RA patterns the proximodistal axis (aldh1a2/cyp26a1 LOF + PMID:17953490). FGF is NOT 'dispensable' (an earlier over-claim I retract): fgf8a single-allele IM is near-normal due to redundancy (fgf8+fgf24 double -> posterior mesoderm lost, PMID:12925590; FGF promotes pronephric fate, PMID:24008197) -- FGF-pathway requirement UNRESOLVED. A baseline zebrafish-expression lens was attempted but DEFERRED (no friction-free JSON API across Expression Atlas/Bgee/ZFIN/Alliance).
